name: CrowdStrike Falcon event streams beside the sensor feed
description: Two CrowdStrike FDR sourcetypes that sit beside the main sensor feed: crowdstrike:events:sensor:ithr, the index-time-host-resolution variant of sensor telemetry (rewritten away at index time by the TA's own transform), and crowdstrike:events:external, the External API Event stream carrying detections and other activity from outside the sensors. Two more sourcetypes join here, from a different pipeline than the FDR ones above: crowdstrike:events (the Falcon Streaming API's audit/API-activity envelope, pulled from a Falcon trial tenant) and crowdstrike:hosts (a device snapshot from the Hosts API's GetDeviceDetailsV2/PostDeviceDetailsV2 response, pulled the same way). Neither has a Splunkbase TA; both sourcetypes are this project's own dev-app definitions.
source: Splunk Add-on for CrowdStrike FDR (Splunk_TA_CrowdStrike_FDR) props and transforms; Splunk Security Content data-source pages; checked against seeded samples. CrowdStrike Falcon Streaming API and Hosts API, pulled into a Splunk index from a Falcon trial tenant; field names cross checked against the public schema at developer.crowdstrike.com on 2026-09-19 where noted.

feed.label: CrowdStrike FDR: sensor:ithr and External API events
feed.description: The two FDR sourcetypes beside the main sensor feed: index-time-host-resolved sensor telemetry (rewritten to crowdstrike:events:sensor before it reaches disk) and the External API event stream carrying detections and other non-sensor activity.

record_kind.label: Record kind
record_kind.description: Which kind of record this row is: the sensor's own event name on crowdstrike:events:sensor:ithr (event_simpleName), the External API event name on crowdstrike:events:external (ExternalApiType). Decides which other columns are filled.

cid.label: Customer id (cid)
cid.description: CrowdStrike's id for the tenant (customer) the record belongs to.

aid.label: Agent id (aid)
aid.description: The Falcon sensor's own id for the host, unique to one sensor install: the stable host key across a rename. Named aid on crowdstrike:events:sensor:ithr; on crowdstrike:events:external this pack binds the same value from SensorId, the field Splunk's own field-reference page for this sourcetype names.

sha256.label: SHA-256
sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file involved: the executing image on crowdstrike:events:sensor:ithr, the file named in the detection's IOC on crowdstrike:events:external.

sha1.label: SHA-1
sha1.description: SHA-1 of the file involved. All zeros in the sensor:ithr ProcessRollup2 sample (unset); malformed (39 characters) in the external sample, see the synthetic_external_sample hazard.

raw_process_id.label: Raw process id
raw_process_id.description: The operating system's own process id (a literal PID), recycled by the OS across process lifetimes. Named RawProcessId on crowdstrike:events:sensor:ithr and ProcessId on crowdstrike:events:external.

target_process_id.label: Target process id
target_process_id.description: A larger, sensor-assigned process number that is the focus of the event, present on almost every sensor:ithr record and named ParentProcessId's counterpart on external. Splunk's ProcessRollup2 field reference lists it as its own field, separate from RawProcessId; see the pid_recycling hazard for the observed magnitude gap between the two.

parent_process_id.label: Parent process id
parent_process_id.description: The same sensor-assigned numbering as target_process_id, for the parent process.

context_process_id.label: Context process id
context_process_id.description: The same sensor-assigned numbering as target_process_id, for the process that generated a file, handle or dump event (FileDeleteInfo, DmpFileWritten, ProcessHandleOpDetectInfo).

source_process_id.label: Source process id
source_process_id.description: The same sensor-assigned numbering as target_process_id, for the process on the other side of a handle operation (ProcessHandleOpDetectInfo's opener).

command_line.label: Command line
command_line.description: The full command line used to start the process.

parent_command_line.label: Parent command line
parent_command_line.description: The full command line of the parent process.

image_file_name.label: Image file name
image_file_name.description: Full device path to the executable (PE) image.

parent_image_file_name.label: Parent image file name
parent_image_file_name.description: Full device path to the parent process's executable image.

parent_base_file_name.label: Parent base file name
parent_base_file_name.description: Base file name (no path) of the parent process's image.

grand_parent_base_file_name.label: Grandparent base file name
grand_parent_base_file_name.description: Base file name (no path) of the grandparent process's image, present on ProcessRollup2 records.

target_file_name.label: Target file name
target_file_name.description: The file the event is about: the file deleted (FileDeleteInfo), the dump written to disk (DmpFileWritten), or, on crowdstrike:events:external, the file the detection produced (AssociatedFile).

event_id.label: Event id
event_id.description: A unique id for one record: id on crowdstrike:events:sensor:ithr, EventUUID on crowdstrike:events:external.

session_id.label: Session id
session_id.description: The Windows logon session id (Windows only), present on ProcessRollup2 records.

event_time.label: Sensor event time
event_time.description: The sensor's own timestamp for the event, epoch milliseconds.

aip.label: Sensor egress IP (aip)
aip.description: The sensor's public IP address as seen by the CrowdStrike cloud at event time; the egress address, not the host's own interface.

event_platform.label: Event platform
event_platform.description: Operating system family the sensor runs on. Only Win is in the seeded sample.

values.Mac: macOS sensor (not seen in the sample)
values.Lin: Linux sensor (not seen in the sample)

process_start_time.label: Process start time
process_start_time.description: When the process began, epoch seconds with a fractional part.

process_end_time.label: Process end time
process_end_time.description: When the process finished, epoch seconds. Empty in the sample's ProcessRollup2 record: the process had not exited when the sensor rolled the event up.

context_timestamp.label: Context time
context_timestamp.description: A second sensor-side timestamp on file, handle and synthetic-rollup records, close to but not identical to the record's own timestamp.

user_sid.label: User SID
user_sid.description: Windows security identifier of the account the process ran as; stable per account where UserName is not.

integrity_level.label: Integrity level
integrity_level.description: Windows Mandatory Integrity Control level of the process, as the numeric RID of its S-1-16-<n> SID.

desired_access.label: Desired access
desired_access.description: The Windows access rights mask requested when one process opened a handle on another; on ProcessHandleOpDetectInfo this is what a credential-dumping tool asked for when it opened lsass.exe. Read by mask, not as one number.

window_title.label: Window title
window_title.description: Title of the process's main window, when it had one.

authentication_id.label: Authentication id
authentication_id.description: The Windows logon authentication id (LUID) of the process's token.

tree_id.label: Tree id
tree_id.description: A sensor-assigned id grouping related events under one process tree.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: A comma-separated list of CrowdStrike's own internal numeric tag ids for the event; no public table of what each number means is in this pack's sources.

event_name_version.label: Event name (versioned)
event_name_version.description: The event's schema name with its version suffix, for example ProcessRollup2V19.

computer_name.label: Computer name
computer_name.description: The host's name as CrowdStrike reported it on the detection.

user_name.label: User name
user_name.description: The account the detected process ran as, DOMAIN\\user form.

machine_domain.label: Machine domain
machine_domain.description: The Windows domain the host is joined to.

local_ip.label: Local IP
local_ip.description: The host's own local network interface address, as the sensor reported it. Distinct from aip on sensor:ithr (the egress address the CrowdStrike cloud sees).

origin_source_ip.label: Origin source IP
origin_source_ip.description: A second address field on the detection record; equal to LocalIP in the seeded sample. No source in this pack's lanes distinguishes its meaning from local_ip.

detect_id.label: Detect id
detect_id.description: CrowdStrike's id for the detection, of the form ldt:<aid>:<counter>; usable in the Detection Resolution and ThreatGraph APIs per Splunk's field reference.

detect_name.label: Detect name
detect_name.description: A short name for the detection.

detect_description.label: Detect description
detect_description.description: A prose description of what the adversary was trying to do and how to start investigating.

severity.label: Severity
severity.description: A numeric severity for the detection; see the severity_scale hazard before treating the number as a small fixed range.

severity_name.label: Severity name
severity_name.description: The word form of Severity, for example Critical. Only Critical is confirmed in this pack's sources; see the severity_scale hazard.

tactic.label: Tactic
tactic.description: The MITRE ATT&CK tactic name CrowdStrike associated with the behavior, for example Credential Access.

technique.label: Technique
technique.description: The MITRE ATT&CK technique name (and id) CrowdStrike associated with the behavior, for example OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory (T1003.001).

objective.label: Objective
objective.description: The MITRE ATT&CK-aligned objective name CrowdStrike associated with the behavior.

pattern_disposition_value.label: Pattern disposition value
pattern_disposition_value.description: The numeric id of the pattern disposition: what action CrowdStrike's policy took on the behavior, packed as a bitmask. The individual named bits (PatternDispositionFlags.Detect, .KillProcess, .QuarantineFile and 17 others) are not bound by this pack; read PatternDispositionDescription for the words.

pattern_disposition_description.label: Pattern disposition description
pattern_disposition_description.description: Words for what PatternDispositionValue means, for example "Detected, standard detection, no action taken."

falcon_host_link.label: Falcon console link
falcon_host_link.description: A URL straight to the detection in the Falcon console.

ioc_type.label: IOC type
ioc_type.description: What kind of indicator IOCValue is. Only hash_sha256 is in the seeded sample.

ioc_value.label: IOC value
ioc_value.description: The indicator value itself; its shape depends on IOCType (a hash in the sample).

host_groups.label: Host groups
host_groups.description: The Falcon host group(s) the machine belongs to, as a JSON array written into one string field.

mac_address.label: MAC address
mac_address.description: The host's network interface hardware address.

file_name.label: File name
file_name.description: Base file name (no path) of the file involved in the detection.

file_path.label: File path
file_path.description: Full path of the file involved in the detection.

grandparent_image_file_name.label: Grandparent image file name
grandparent_image_file_name.description: Full path to the grandparent process's executable image.

grandparent_command_line.label: Grandparent command line
grandparent_command_line.description: The full command line of the grandparent process.

record_kind_raw.label: Record kind (raw EventType)
record_kind_raw.description: A duplicate of record_kind's value with the Event_ prefix stripped, from the raw event's own EventType key. Splunk indexes it as extracted_EventType because eventtype is a reserved field name.

event_time_iso.label: Event time (ISO 8601)
event_time_iso.description: A duplicate of UTCTimestamp in human-readable ISO 8601 form.

event_sequence.label: Event sequence (eid)
event_sequence.description: A small integer on the record; its exact meaning (a per-file or per-session sequence number) is not confirmed in this pack's sources. 1 in the seeded sample.

nonce.label: Nonce
nonce.description: A small integer field on the record; its purpose is not confirmed in this pack's sources.

device_id.label: Device id (device_id)
device_id.description: CrowdStrike's identifier for the host, on the device record the Hosts API returns.

external_ip.label: External IP
external_ip.description: The host's public IP address as the Hosts API reports it.

host_platform.label: Platform name (platform_name)
host_platform.description: The host's OS platform family, as the Hosts API names it.

host_product_type.label: Product type (product_type_desc)
host_product_type.description: What kind of endpoint the Hosts API considers this: workstation, server and so on.

host_os_version.label: OS version
host_os_version.description: The operating system version string as CrowdStrike's sensor reported it to the cloud.

sensor_agent_version.label: Falcon sensor version (agent_version)
sensor_agent_version.description: The installed Falcon sensor's version string.

host_first_seen.label: Host first seen
host_first_seen.description: When CrowdStrike's cloud first recorded this host.

host_last_seen.label: Host last seen
host_last_seen.description: When CrowdStrike's cloud last heard from this host's sensor.

last_login_user.label: Last login user
last_login_user.description: The account name of the last interactive login the sensor observed on the host.

last_login_user_sid.label: Last login user SID
last_login_user_sid.description: The Windows security identifier of the last interactive login's account.

host_status.label: Status (status)
host_status.description: The host record's own status field, as the Hosts API names it.

provision_status.label: Provision status
provision_status.description: Where the host sits in CrowdStrike's provisioning flow.

rtr_state.label: Real Time Response state (rtr_state)
rtr_state.description: Whether Real Time Response is enabled for the host, as the field names it.

reduced_functionality_mode.label: Reduced functionality mode
reduced_functionality_mode.description: Whether the sensor is running in a degraded state with reduced capability.

safe_mode.label: Safe mode
safe_mode.description: Whether the host was last seen booted into an OS safe mode.

filesystem_containment_status.label: Filesystem containment status
filesystem_containment_status.description: Whether CrowdStrike's network containment is applied to the host's filesystem access.

host_criticality.label: Criticality
host_criticality.description: An asset-criticality tag an analyst or policy can set on the host.

chassis_type_desc.label: Chassis type
chassis_type_desc.description: The hardware chassis type CrowdStrike inferred for the host.

system_manufacturer.label: System manufacturer
system_manufacturer.description: The hardware manufacturer string the sensor read from the host.

system_product_name.label: System product name
system_product_name.description: The hardware model string the sensor read from the host.

host_serial_number.label: Serial number
host_serial_number.description: The hardware serial number the sensor read from the host.

host_group_hash.label: Host group hash (group_hash)
host_group_hash.description: A hash CrowdStrike derives from the host's group membership; changes when group membership changes.

policy_type.label: Policy type
policy_type.description: Which policy category a device_policies entry is for (sensor update, prevention and so on); this pack binds one representative entry, sensor_update, out of eight device_policies categories the record carries.

policy_id.label: Policy id
policy_id.description: The id of the policy applied to the host for one policy category.

policy_applied.label: Policy applied
policy_applied.description: Whether the assigned policy has actually been applied to the host.

policy_applied_date.label: Policy applied date
policy_applied_date.description: When the assigned policy was applied to the host.

policy_assigned_date.label: Policy assigned date
policy_assigned_date.description: When the policy was assigned to the host (may predate applied_date).

audit_event_type.label: Audit event type (metadata.eventType)
audit_event_type.description: The streaming envelope's own category name for the record.

audit_category.label: Audit category
audit_category.description: Which CrowdStrike service or channel produced the record; event.Category, event.ServiceName and event.Source carry the same small value set in the sample and are bound to this one concept.

audit_action.label: Audit action
audit_action.description: The specific action or lifecycle event the audit record names.

actor_type_code.label: Actor type code
actor_type_code.description: A small integer code for the kind of actor that performed the action.

actor_id.label: Actor id
actor_id.description: An id for who or what performed the action (a user id or a client id, depending on actor_type_code).

api_client_id.label: API client id
api_client_id.description: The OAuth2 API client id that made the request, when the actor was an API client.

request_method.label: Request method
request_method.description: The HTTP method of the API request the audit record covers.

audit_status_code.label: Status code
audit_status_code.description: The HTTP status code the API request returned.

target_type_code.label: Target type code
target_type_code.description: A code naming the kind of object the action targeted.

audit_geo_country.label: Actor geo country
audit_geo_country.description: The country CrowdStrike attributed to the request's origin.

stream_offset.label: Stream offset (offset)
stream_offset.description: The Streaming API's position marker for the record, used to resume a feed without loss or duplication.

envelope_version.label: Envelope version
envelope_version.description: The streaming envelope's own schema version string.

crowdstrike:events:sensor:ithr.description: Falcon sensor telemetry indexed with index-time host resolution enabled (cs_ithr_type). The Splunk_TA_CrowdStrike_FDR ships this stanza as a byte-identical copy of crowdstrike:events:sensor's props; the TA's own transforms.conf then rewrites every event's sourcetype to crowdstrike:events:sensor unconditionally before it reaches disk, so events landing under this literal sourcetype name are not observable in a normally configured install.
crowdstrike:events:sensor:ithr.note: Dev Splunk confirms the rewrite: 43 seeded events all landed as sourcetype=crowdstrike:events:sensor. Fields and examples here come from the same NDJSON sample (Splunk's attack_data T1003.001 corpus), read before the rewrite.

crowdstrike:events:external.description: CrowdStrike external security events: activity outside the sensors, delivered through FDR's External API Event stream (ExternalApiType). Only Event_DetectionSummaryEvent (a Falcon detection) is in the dev workspace's seeded data; CrowdStrike's Event Streams API also emits AuthActivityAuditEvent, UserActivityAuditEvent and IncidentSummaryEvent under the same sourcetype shape, not confirmed here.
crowdstrike:events:external.note: collect_external_events defaults to 0 in inputs.conf; the TA does not forward this sourcetype until an admin turns it on. The dev Splunk's one record is a hand-seeded row (source=/tmp/seed/detection-attack.json), not vendor-published; see the synthetic_external_sample hazard. The raw JSON's own EventType key collides with Splunk's reserved eventtype field and is indexed as extracted_EventType; ExternalApiType (Event_-prefixed) is the field this pack binds as record_kind.

crowdstrike:hosts.description: A device snapshot from the Falcon Hosts API (GetDeviceDetailsV2 / PostDeviceDetailsV2), one JSON object per host, pulled from a Falcon trial tenant. Not a Splunkbase TA sourcetype; the stanza is the repo's own dev-app definition (DATETIME_CONFIG=CURRENT, so index time is the event time, not a field CrowdStrike sends).
crowdstrike:hosts.note: 106 fields observed in the dev Splunk (index=crowdstrike, 4 devices from one Falcon trial tenant). Field names cross checked against the public schema at developer.crowdstrike.com/api-reference/collections/hosts/ (read 2026-09-19), which renders every field as a JSON-Schema placeholder ("string", "0") with no description text to cite.

crowdstrike:events.description: The Falcon Streaming API's audit/API-activity envelope: a metadata block (customerIDString, offset, eventType, eventCreationTime, version) wrapping an event body, pulled from the /sensors/entities/datafeed/v2 connection on a Falcon trial tenant. Not a Splunkbase TA sourcetype; the stanza is the repo's own dev-app definition (KV_MODE=json, TIME_PREFIX on eventCreationTime).
crowdstrike:events.note: 91 fields observed in the dev Splunk (index=crowdstrike, 467 records from one Falcon trial tenant, all AuthActivityAuditEvent/APIActivityAuditEvent/AuditLogV3Event). The event body carries two parallel field sets, Attributes.* and Extensions.*, that repeat the same request/audit fields under different keys (Category values api_request vs Crowdstrike API Client/Streaming API); this pack binds the Extensions.* copy and leaves Attributes.* unbound. developer.crowdstrike.com/api-reference/collections/event-streams/ documents only the datafeed-discovery operations (listAvailableStreamsOAuth2, refreshActiveStreamSession), not this envelope or its eventType values; read 2026-09-19.

provenance.statement: INDEXED_EXTRACTIONS=json flattens the raw NDJSON body; event_simpleName is a top-level key.

pid_recycling.text: RawProcessId (sensor:ithr) and ProcessId (external) are literal OS process ids, recycled across process lifetimes on the host. TargetProcessId, ParentProcessId, ContextProcessId and SourceProcessId are a different, larger numbering the sensor assigns per process; in the sample RawProcessId is a small number (4036) while TargetProcessId/ParentProcessId are nine digits (307075862, 332855234). Splunk's own ProcessRollup2 field-reference page lists RawProcessId and TargetProcessId as separate fields; this pack does not have a documented source for why the two ranges differ, only that the sample shows they do.

time_fields.text: event_ingest_time is set by the TA's own crowdstrike_ta_event_ingest_time transform (INGEST_EVAL = event_ingest_time=time()) at index time; it is Splunk's own ingest clock, not a field CrowdStrike sends, and this pack does not bind it as a time concept. The event's own times are timestamp (sensor:ithr, also duplicated in ISO 8601 form on external's timestamp field) and UTCTimestamp (external), both epoch milliseconds; ProcessStartTime and ProcessEndTime are epoch seconds and can be empty when a process is still running or the sensor never saw it end.

id_namespaces.text: cid (tenant), aid/SensorId (sensor install), id/EventUUID (one record), eid (a small per-record sequence number) and DetectId (one detection, itself built from the aid plus a counter, ldt:<aid>:<n>) are five different id spaces that can all look like hex strings, GUIDs or plain integers; a match on one says nothing about the others.

severity_scale.text: The sample's one external record carries Severity=90 with SeverityName=Critical. This pack has no source in its allowed lanes (the TA's own docs, or a Splunk-published field reference) for what range Severity is drawn from or what other SeverityName words exist; do not assume a small fixed scale from the single observed pair.

synthetic_external_sample.text: The only crowdstrike:events:external record in the dev Splunk is a single hand-built row at source=/tmp/seed/detection-attack.json, seeded to narrate the same T1003.001 credential-dumping scenario as the sensor:ithr sample (same aid, cid, procdump.exe, timestamps). It is genuinely indexed (an observed event), but it is not vendor-published data: its SHA1String value is 39 characters (one short of a valid SHA-1) and its MD5String is the MD5 of the literal string 'password'. Treat its field values as illustrative shapes, not as evidence of what CrowdStrike actually emits.

device_id_namespace.text: device_id (crowdstrike:hosts, from the Hosts API) is a sixth id space beside the five already listed in id_namespaces: this pack has no source in an allowed lane stating device_id and aid/SensorId (the sensor telemetry sourcetypes) are the same value for the same host.

undocumented_codes.text: event.ActorType (crowdstrike:events) is observed only as the raw integers 1, 2 and 3; event.TargetType is observed only as 0. No source in an allowed lane (CrowdStrike's own docs, or Splunk's) gives these codes names. Treat them as opaque until a source turns up.

small_dev_tenant.text: crowdstrike:hosts holds 4 devices and crowdstrike:events holds 467 records, all from one Falcon trial tenant (index=crowdstrike in the dev Splunk). Every enumerated value in this pack for these two sourcetypes (platform_name=Mac, product_type_desc=Workstation, chassis_type_desc=Other, event.Category's three literals, and so on) is only what this one small population showed; other CrowdStrike-documented literals (Windows, Linux, other chassis types, other audit categories) are not confirmed absent, only unobserved here.

tenant_values_excluded.text: crowdstrike:hosts and crowdstrike:events carry the trial tenant's own hostnames, IPs, MAC addresses, usernames, SIDs, serial numbers and client/actor ids. The raw pulled files are kept out of the repository for the same reason; this pack does not copy those values into an example either. Fields bound below for identity or network columns carry a format description but no example value.

edges.label: Everything this host reported
edges.basis_ref: aid/SensorId rides on every sensor and external event
